404.title: Muslim Medical Mission | Free healthcare and relief in Pakistan and Gaza
404.description: Muslim Medical Mission is a volunteer network of doctors, paramedics and students running free medical camps, disaster relief, clean water and food distribution across Pakistan and into Gaza.

about.title: Who we are
about.description: Muslim Medical Mission Foundation is a volunteer network of Muslim healthcare professionals delivering free medical care and relief across Pakistan and into Gaza.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Reach Muslim Medical Mission Foundation in Model Town, Lahore, by phone, WhatsApp or email.

disaster-response.title: Disaster response
disaster-response.description: How Muslim Medical Mission mobilises for floods and emergencies across Pakistan, from first assessment to sustained medical camps and ration distribution.

donate.title: Donate
donate.description: Fund free medical camps, ration packs, clean water and winter relief. Bank transfer, JazzCash and EasyPaisa details for Muslim Medical Mission Foundation.

get-involved.title: Membership
get-involved.description: Muslim Medical Mission (MMM) Pakistan brings together doctors, dentists, physiotherapists, nurses, pharmacists, allied health professionals, students, and volunteers who share one purpose: serving humanity.

index.html.title: Muslim Medical Mission | Free healthcare and relief in Pakistan and Gaza
index.html.description: Muslim Medical Mission is a volunteer network of doctors, paramedics and students running free medical camps, disaster relief, clean water and food distribution across Pakistan and into Gaza.

media/bls-rescue-1122.title: Emergency First Responder Training in collaboration with Punjab Rescue 1122
media/bls-rescue-1122.description: Hands-on trauma management, BLS, haemorrhage control, and disaster triage workshops training volunteers to act as certified lifesavers in emergencies.

media/gaza-food-parcels-and-hot-meals.title: Food parcels and hot meals for displaced families in Gaza
media/gaza-food-parcels-and-hot-meals.description: Family food parcels are delivered to displaced households, with hot meals provided where families have no way to cook.

media.title: Media and field reports
media.description: Photographs and field reports from Muslim Medical Mission deployments across Pakistan and Gaza.

media/one-million-patients.title: More than 1,000,000 patients given free consultation and medicine
media/one-million-patients.description: Free medical camps are held in various cities and towns according to a preset schedule. Local population is also involved for logistic support. A special focus is put on underdeveloped districts and rural areas. In addition to Punjab we have successfully organized free medical camps in Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Karachi, Tharparkar, interior Sindh, Balochistan and Gilgit Baltistan.

media/surgical-camp-central-jail.title: Free Surgical Camp at Central Jail Kot Lakhpat and District Facilities
media/surgical-camp-central-jail.description: Volunteer consultant surgeons conducted vital procedures and provided specialized medication for incarcerated and underprivileged patients who otherwise had zero access to surgery.

media/taunsa-flood-response.title: Emergency boat deployment and medical relief along the rising Indus
media/taunsa-flood-response.description: Rapid response disaster teams led by senior clinicians mobilized emergency relief boats, setting up frontline triage and treating waterborne illnesses where roads had washed out.

what-we-do/flood-medical-camps.title: Flood emergency medical camps
what-we-do/flood-medical-camps.description: During flood emergencies, Muslim Medical Mission provides free medical camps in affected communities. Teams offer medical consultations, basic treatment, essential medicines, and referrals where further care is needed.

what-we-do/flood-relief.title: Flood relief distribution
what-we-do/flood-relief.description: Muslim Medical Mission provides flood relief to affected communities in South Punjab and Balochistan. Support includes staple food, clean drinking water, and cash assistance for households facing significant losses.

what-we-do/food-parcels-gaza.title: Food parcels and hot meals
what-we-do/food-parcels-gaza.description: Family food parcels handed over at the shelter door, and hot meals cooked and served where families have no way to cook at all.

what-we-do/gaza-field-clinics.title: Field clinics in Gaza
what-we-do/gaza-field-clinics.description: Paramedic and clinical teams running consultations, dressings, dispensing and paediatric care inside shelters and tented clinics.

what-we-do/health-education.title: Health education campaigns
what-we-do/health-education.description: Public awareness work on outbreaks, hygiene, maternal health and vaccination, delivered through mosques, schools and community halls.

what-we-do.title: What we do
what-we-do.description: Free medical camps, Save Vision, prison healthcare, health education, disaster relief, rations, clean water, winter packages and paramedic training.

what-we-do/prison-healthcare.title: Medical care in prisons
what-we-do/prison-healthcare.description: Muslim Medical Mission provides scheduled medical care in correctional facilities, including clinical consultations, basic treatment, communicable disease screening, and hospital referrals when further care is required.

what-we-do/professional-development.title: Professional development
what-we-do/professional-development.description: Continuing education for Muslim healthcare professionals, and the ethical grounding that sits underneath the clinical work.

what-we-do/save-vision.title: Save Vision
what-we-do/save-vision.description: Save Vision provides basic eye screening at medical camps, distributes reading glasses where needed, and refers patients requiring cataract surgery to partner hospitals for further treatment.

what-we-do/training.title: Paramedic and first responder training
what-we-do/training.description: Turning volunteers into people who can hold a scene, stop a bleed and keep an airway open until a doctor arrives.

what-we-do/water-for-life.title: Water for Life
what-we-do/water-for-life.description: Muslim Medical Mission provides drinking water to communities affected by damaged or unavailable water infrastructure. Water tankers supply camps and shelters with water for household and communal use.

what-we-do/winter-packages.title: Winter packages
what-we-do/winter-packages.description: Quilts, blankets and warm clothing for families living under canvas through a Gaza winter.

zakat-calculator.title: Zakat Calculator
zakat-calculator.description: Calculate your Zakat based on 2.5% of your Zakat-eligible amount, with today's live silver and gold Nisab thresholds.
